pages.excerpt:
The**Ministry for Gozo**([Maltese](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maltese_language):Ministeru għal Għawdex) formerly**Ministry for Gozo and Planning**is the ministry of the[Government of Malta](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Government_of_Malta)with responsibility for the island of[Gozo](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gozo). It was established in 1987.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ministry_for_Gozo#cite_note-1)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ministry_for_Gozo#cite_note-2)

On 4 June 2026,[during the reshuffle of the cabinet](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maltese_Government_2026%E2%80%932030?action=edit&redlink=1#June_20246_%E2%80%93_present), the ministry was renamed to the**Ministry for Gozo**.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ministry_for_Gozo#cite_note-3)
